title: Rogue #1 Marvel 2004 Rodolfo Migliari Painted Cover Robert Rodi Cliff Richards
conditionDescription: Small chip at the top right corner and light spotting near the title on the front; light spotting along the bottom edge of the back cover. See photos.
descriptionText:
Rogue #1 (September 2004, vol. 3), Marvel Comics - first issue of the ongoing series. Written by Robert Rodi, art by Cliff Richards and Norm Rapmund; painted cover by Rodolfo Migliari. Direct edition, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Juicee Gummee candy ad.

Condition: small chip at the top right corner and light spotting near the title on the front cover; light spotting along the bottom edge of the back cover (see close-up photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
